chunks: ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who finds a mouse in his vessel after he had performed wudu (ablution) from that vessel several times, or performed ghusl from it, or washed his clothes with it, while the mouse had already become decomposed.

He said: “If he had seen it in the vessel before performing ghusl, or wudu (ablution), or washing his clothes, and then did that after he had seen it in the vessel, then he must wash his clothes, wash everything that was touched by that water, and repeat the wudu (ablution) and the salat (prayer).”

And if he only saw it after he had finished that and doing it, then he should not use any of the water, and there is nothing upon him, because he does not know when it fell into it.” Then he said: “Perhaps it only fell into it at that very hour in which he saw it.”

key_terms.إِنَائِهِ: his vessel or container holding the water
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the salat (prayer) that must be repeated in one case
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: the ritual wudu (ablution) that must be repeated in one case
key_terms.فَأْرَةً: a mouse found in the vessel as the source of impurity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone finds a dead mouse in water after using it for wudu (ablution), ghusl, or washing clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning water contaminated by a dead mouse and the effect of prior knowledge on ritual accountability. If the impurity was seen before using the water, the acts done with it must be remedied; if it was only discovered afterward, no repetition is required because the time of contamination is unknown.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.26 - Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who finds a dead mouse in his container after having used it multiple times for ablution, ghusl (ritual washing), or washing his clothes. The mouse was already decayed.

Imam (as) said: "If he saw it in the container before performing ablution, ghusl, or washing his clothes, and still used the water afterward, then he must wash his clothes, wash everything that came into contact with that water, and repeat his ablution and prayer. However, if he only noticed the mouse after he had finished, then he should avoid using the water, but he is not required to repeat anything, as he does not know when it fell into the container."
Imam (as) said: "It is possible that it only fell into the container at the moment he saw it."
